name: promotion-schema
title: Promotion JSON Schema
description: A JSON Schema for what parsePromotion accepts, built from the parser's own constants, so an assistant or a CMS can write a valid campaign on the first try.
docs: Paste JSON.stringify(promotionJsonSchema) into a prompt, or serve it for your CMS. parsePromotion stays the judge for what a schema cannot say (allowed links, route patterns, a window that ends after it starts). Published at https://kitsulab.kitsunekode.in/schema/promotion.json. Size: about 2 kB gzipped of its own, 2 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).
